## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle early-Qīng commentary on the *Bā shí guījǔ sòng* 八識規矩頌 expounded orally by [性起](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%80%A7%E8%B5%B7) **Miàodé Xìngqǐ** and recorded by his disciples — chiefly [善漳](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E6%BC%B3) **Shànzhāng** — under his direction. Preserved in the *Manji Xuzangjing* 卍續藏 at X55n0898. The function-markers (*lùnshì* 論釋 for the master, *děng lù* 等錄 for the disciples) confirm that this is a *yǔlù*-style record of the master's lectures, edited and circulated under his name.

**Abstract**

The *Lùnyì* is one of the principal early-Qīng *guījǔ* commentaries from outside the Cí'ēn-philological mainstream — closer in spirit to Hānshān's [KR6n0135](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0135) *Tōngshuō* and Zhènghuì's [KR6n0133](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0133) *Lüèshuō* than to Pǔtài's [KR6n0131](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0131) *Bǔzhù* or Míngyù's [KR6n0132](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0132) *Zhèngyì*. The work is a witness to the continuing practice of *yǔlù*-style oral exposition of the basic Yogācāra didactic texts in early-Qīng Buddhist monastic education; it preserves Xìngqǐ's distinctive Tathāgatagarbha-flavoured reading of the *guījǔ*.

The dating window 1644–1722 brackets the early-Qīng productive period of Xìngqǐ; lifedates are not securely attested for either Xìngqǐ or Shànzhāng.
